subject: The Hive Mind OS codebase is intended to be a self-operating operating system that learns and solves problems end-to-end without avoidable human interaction. When it suspects cheating or believes it needs a human answer, it must first consult applicable roles because those roles may resolve the question. The current roles are not yet fully wired into one real runtime.
